name: Flow Beverage Corp.
summary: Flow Beverage Corp. operates as a health and wellness-oriented beverage enterprise, manufacturing and distributing alkaline spring water across the United States and Canada. Their product range encompasses original, unflavored, naturally flavored, and collagen-fortified options. The diverse flavor portfolio includes a variety of fruit and botanical infusions, such as blackberry+hibiscus, grapefruit+elderflower, strawberry+rose, and numerous other refreshing combinations. Marketed under the "Flow" brand, these beverages reach consumers via multiple channels, including direct sales, third-party distributors, direct store delivery services, and e-commerce platforms. Established in 2014 as RG One Corp., the firm rebranded to Flow Beverage Corp. in April 2021 and maintains its headquarters in Aurora, Canada.
